title: Panko Crusted Mussel Boats
subtitle: with savoury rice & a creamy lemon sauce
description: A traditional seafood dish reminiscent of being whisked away to a small town by the ocean. Mouthfuls of these gorgeous cheesy crumb-filled mussels and savoury rice, laced with beautifully charred vegetables, can only be perfected by the drizzles of a lemon and white wine creamy sauce. Not a drop to be wasted!

ingredients.name: Cheesy Crumb
ingredients.prep: 200ml Panko Breadcrumbs & 60ml Grated Italian-style Hard Cheese

instructions.title: STEAMY RICE
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the rice and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 600ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 8-10 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork. Cover to keep warm and set aside.

instructions.title: CHARRED VEGGIES
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced baby marrow pieces for 6-7 minutes until charred. Remove from the pan on completion and place in a bowl. Return the pan to the heat with another drizzle of oil. Fry the diced carrots for 8-10 minutes until browned and caramelized. Remove from the pan and add to the bowl of baby marrows. Season to taste.

instructions.title: NICE RICE
instructions.text: Once the rice is cooked, stir through the peas, charred carrots and baby marrow pieces. Cover to keep warm for serving.

instructions.title: LEMON CREAM SAUCE
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan if necessary and return it to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onions for 6-8 minutes until soft and translucent, shifting occasionally. Add in the grated garlic and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly. Pour in the white wine and cook off until almost evaporated. Turn off the heat and stir through the cream and the juice of 4 lemon wedges. Season to taste, remove from the heat and cover.

instructions.title: LACED CRUMB & CRISP MUSSELS
instructions.text: In a small bowl combine the cheesy crumb with ½ of the chopped parsley. Add lemon zest and seasoning to taste. Place the mussel halves onto a roasting tray. Fill each one with 1-2 tsp of the cream sauce and a generous heap of the parsley and cheese crumb. Pop them into the oven to bake for 4-5 minutes until the crumb is crispy.

instructions.title: TIME FOR A FLAVOUR TRIP!
instructions.text: Plate up a gorgeous mound of veggie packed fluffy rice and nestle in the crispy mussel boats. Drizzle over the remaining creamy lemon sauce and finish off with a garnish of the remaining chopped parsley. What a feast!
